built_by: Claude, from the PDF text, starting from the Ignite 1099 rules. Every quote was matched word for word to this PDF, and rules whose wording isn't in it were left out.

rules.label: Baltimore / Philadelphia investment
rules.quote: Investment Properties in Baltimore, MD and Philadelphia, PA are ineligible.

rules.label: First time home buyer on an investment
rules.quote: Borrower with Rental History: 0x30x12, Primary or Second Home Only

rules.label: First time home buyer, no rental history / rent free
rules.quote: Borrower without Rental History/Living Rent Free: Must meet trade line requirement, max 80% LTV/CLTV, min 680 FICO

rules.label: Rent free borrower under 680 FICO
rules.quote: Borrower without Rental History/Living Rent Free: Must meet trade line requirement, max 80% LTV/CLTV, min 680 FICO

rules.label: Rent free borrower over $1.5MM
rules.quote: No Gift, No Non-Occupant Co-Borrower. Maximum Loan Amount $1.5MM.

rules.label: Credit event 24 to 35 months ago
rules.quote: 36 months OR 24 months with a 5% reduction from maximum qualifying LTV.

rules.label: Credit event under 24 months ago
rules.quote: 36 months OR 24 months with a 5% reduction from maximum qualifying LTV.

rules.label: More than one 30-day mortgage late (no 60s)
rules.quote: Unlimited 30 days 0X60X12 allowed with a 5% reduction from maximum qualifying LTV.

rules.label: 60-day mortgage late in 12 months
rules.confirm: Read as: any 60-day late in 12 months doesn't meet 1x30x12 or 0x60x12. Confirm with underwriting.

rules.label: Non-occupant co-borrower
rules.quote: Purchase or Rate and Term on Primary Only. Reduce LTV/CLTV from maximum qualifying by 5%.

rules.label: Non-occupant co-borrower on cash out or non-primary
rules.quote: Purchase or Rate and Term on Primary Only.

rules.label: Cash out, owned under 6 months
rules.quote: If purchased less than 6 months prior to application date a 5% reduction from maximum qualifying LTV is required

rules.label: Texas 50(a)(6) cash out
rules.quote: Texas Home Equity 50(a)(6) Cash Out | 80% LTV/CLTV Max.

rules.label: Texas 50(a)(6) on non-primary or 2+ units
rules.quote: One Unit Principal residences and claimed as Borrower's homestead.
